title: 緑から赤へ、そして戻る：実研究映像で見るカメレオンの色の理由
viewerPromise: Same animal appears green vs colorful in original filmed experiment; the body visibly changes even as background stays dark.
finalPayoff: Excitation/social signalling, and footage of colors subsiding, explain why the animal becomes conspicuous rather than hidden.
